policy.summary: Every factual assertion about AquaPure that a reader could check lives here. Nothing in this file is published unless its status says so. See docs/CLAIMS.md.

statuses.verified: Evidence exists, is recorded in `source`, and was checked on `lastVerified`. Publishable.
statuses.self_asserted: A first-person operational statement about how the business runs (what it offers, where it goes, how it quotes). Not third-party verifiable and does not claim to be. Publishable, phrased as the business's own statement.
statuses.unverified: No evidence on file. NOT publishable — not in copy, not in metadata, not in structured data, not in generated content.
statuses.expired: Was verified, but `reverifyAfterDays` has elapsed. Treated exactly like unverified until re-checked.
statuses.prohibited: Must never be published regardless of evidence (superlatives, guarantees, health claims).

rules: `allowedForPublication` must agree with `status` or the build fails — see lib/claims.ts.
A quantitative claim (counts, ratings, years, prices, percentages about the business) needs `source`. A regulatory, certification or licence claim needs `source`.
Statistics, ratings, review counts, certifications and licences are never `self_asserted`. They are `unverified` until evidence is filed.
Superlatives (#1, best, leading) are `prohibited` and cannot be unlocked by editing a status.

claims.claim: AquaPure serves all seven Emirates: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah and Umm Al Quwain.
claims.source: content/locations.json — the coverage the business publishes and staffs.

claims.claim: Mobile teams are based in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah, with scheduled routes covering the northern Emirates.
claims.source: Business operating model as stated by the owner.

claims.claim: Same-day attendance is usually available in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah; northern Emirates are typically within 24 to 48 hours.
claims.source: content/locations.json responseTime per emirate. Phrased as typical, never guaranteed.
claims.notes: Must stay hedged ('usually', 'typically'). A hard guarantee would need measured dispatch data and would move to `unverified`.

claims.claim: The emergency call-out line is answered 24 hours a day, every day.
claims.source: Published service commitment; reflected in content/business.json hours.

claims.claim: The on-site water test and consultation are free and carry no obligation.
A fixed written quotation in AED is given before work starts, with no call-out fee.
Only manufacturer-supplied cartridges, membranes and pumps are fitted.
Systems installed by other companies are serviced and repaired, across all major brands.
Enquiries are answered in English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu and Malayalam.
AquaPure operates from Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
claims.source: content/business.json — address as supplied by the business.
claims.notes: TODO(owner): add unit/building number and make this string match the Google Business Profile character for character. NAP mismatch is the most common cause of weak local ranking.

claims.claim: The premises are at latitude 25.1193, longitude 55.2277.
claims.notes: Approximate area centroid, not a surveyed pin. Wrong coordinates actively damage local ranking, so `geo` is omitted from LocalBusiness until the owner supplies the exact pin from Google Maps.

claims.claim: AquaPure has served 12,000+ UAE households and businesses.
claims.notes: Needs a count from the job/CRM records with the date the count was taken.

claims.claim: AquaPure holds an average customer rating of 4.9 out of 5.
claims.notes: Publishing a rating without a verifiable public review profile breaches Google's review-snippet policy. Needs a Google Business Profile or equivalent, and the figure must be read from it.

claims.claim: AquaPure has 1,284 customer reviews.
AquaPure has 15 years of experience, having been founded in 2010.
claims.notes: Needs the trade-licence issue date. Once filed, publish the founding year and derive the years automatically rather than hardcoding a number that silently goes stale.

claims.claim: AquaPure is a licensed UAE business holding a DED trade licence.
claims.notes: Needs the trade-licence number, issuing authority and expiry. This is the single highest-value claim to verify: it is what separates a real local business from a lead-generation page in both Google's and an AI system's eyes.

claims.claim: Installations comply with Dubai Municipality plumbing standards.
claims.notes: Needs the specific approval, registration or code reference. 'Compliant' with no citation is not publishable.

claims.claim: Equipment supplied is ESMA approved.
claims.notes: Terminology is also out of date: ESMA was folded into the Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology (MOIAT) in 2020. Any republished version should name the current scheme and cite a certificate per product.

claims.claim: Filtration components are NSF and/or WQA certified.
claims.notes: NSF and WQA certify specific products against specific standards (e.g. NSF/ANSI 58 for RO). Needs per-product certificate numbers; a blanket claim is not publishable.

claims.claim: Technicians are fully insured, including third-party liability.
claims.notes: Needs the policy number, insurer and cover period.

claims.claim: Technicians are certified.
claims.notes: 'Certified' must name the certification body and scheme. Until then the publishable version is the operational statement in `technicians_trained`.

claims.claim: The person who attends is a trained plumber and filtration technician who can diagnose and repair on site, not a salesperson.
AMC customers pay 30 to 40% less than they would paying per visit.
claims.notes: A price comparison needs both price lists to exist. Neither is published.

claims.claim: A typical under-sink installation takes about an hour.
claims.source: Stated typical job duration. Phrased as typical, not guaranteed.

claims.claim: The named customer testimonials on the site are genuine, attributable and used with permission.
claims.notes: Until each testimonial has a verifiable origin (a public review URL, or a written consent record), no testimonial is rendered and no Review/AggregateRating schema is emitted. See content/testimonials.json `verification`.

claims.claim: Reverse osmosis membranes typically reject 95 to 99% of total dissolved solids.
claims.source: Standard rejection range published on residential RO membrane datasheets (NSF/ANSI 58 is the certification standard for RO drinking-water systems). Industry-general, not an AquaPure performance measurement.
claims.notes: Publish as a range and as a property of the technology. Never as a measured AquaPure result, and never as a number for a specific customer's water.

claims.claim: UV disinfection inactivates upwards of 99.9% of common waterborne bacteria and viruses when the lamp delivers its rated dose to clear water.
claims.source: Standard UV dose–response behaviour; NSF/ANSI 55 is the certification standard for UV drinking-water systems. Effectiveness is dose-dependent.
claims.notes: The dose and water-clarity caveat must travel with the figure. UV does not remove dissolved solids and does not work through turbid water.

claims.claim: Mains drinking water in the UAE is predominantly produced by seawater desalination.
claims.source: Long-standing, widely documented characteristic of UAE municipal supply, reported by the emirate utilities (DEWA, ADDC, SEWA, Etihad Water and Electricity).
claims.notes: TODO(owner): add direct links to each utility's published water-quality page — see docs/KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md. Qualitative statement only; no numeric water-quality figure is published from this claim.

claims.claim: Water quality at the tap can differ from quality at the plant, because water passes through distribution pipework and is commonly held in building or rooftop storage tanks before use.
claims.source: General water-distribution engineering; the reason point-of-use treatment and tank cleaning are regulated activities in the UAE.

claims.claim: Specific TDS or hardness figures for a named emirate or neighbourhood.
claims.notes: No numeric local water-quality figure is published. Real values vary by supply zone, blending, season and building storage, and must come from the utility's own report or from a measurement on the property. Content says 'measured on site' instead of quoting a number.

claims.claim: Prices, price ranges or 'starting from' figures in AED for any product or service.
claims.notes: No price list exists in this repository. Content explains what drives cost and directs the reader to a free on-site quotation. No Offer/priceRange appears in structured data.

claims.claim: AquaPure is the best, #1, leading or top-rated water filtration company in Dubai or the UAE.
claims.notes: Unfalsifiable comparative advertising. Blocked at the validator, and cannot be unlocked by changing a status.

claims.claim: Filtered water prevents, treats or cures any illness or medical condition.
claims.notes: Medical claim. Content may describe what a technology removes; it may never describe a health outcome.

claims.claim: Any absolute guarantee that water is safe, pure, or 100% free of contaminants.
claims.notes: No treatment system can be described in absolutes. Publishable language is what the technology reduces or inactivates, with its limits.
